Run-retention implementation is being built only in the isolated candidate. Request gains explicit source ColumnIds for retained run coefficients, default empty/off; each active run projects those IDs into its native run-local axis. Existing QR coordinates feed only the extra requested rows. Primary pooling and optional primary uncertainty remain independent, with an explicit NotRequested/Retained run product and per-run voxel statuses. Shared OLS and public pooling-only result APIs must refuse run retention they cannot supply instead of silently ignoring it.

The new product reuses public runwise axis lowering. That review reproduced an existing metadata loss: UnitMaximumAbsolute FIR amplitude scaling divisor3 becomes AsConvolved/divisor1 through CoefficientAxis.forRunwiseCoefficient. A public convolution -> schema -> run-axis test fails at exact baseline design source13b11ad6c8a61c5dee90bff55a6af094036802f97b905f772ebd785c196cc316;12other DesignSchemaSuite tests pass. Raw failure /private/tmp/plsneuro-run-retention-scale-repro-1.log and source/process receipts retained. Candidate fixes the existing constructor call by preserving column.hrfScale; no matrix or scientific coefficient value changes. This small related metadata correction will be qualified with the run-retention JVM/Scala.js gates, not patched around in the application. Nothing in this new slice is yet admitted or synced to native source.
